findings.quoted_text: Upon delivery of each Milestone, Developer assigns to Client all right, title, and interest, including copyrights and patent rights, in and to the custom software code, database schemas, and visual assets developed under this Agreement.
Client shall pay each milestone amount within ninety (90) days after Client's final acceptance of the complete Software.

Upon delivery of each Milestone, Developer assigns to Client all right, title, and interest, including copyrights and patent rights, in and to the custom software code, database schemas, and visual assets developed under this Agreement.
findings.explanation: Intellectual property rights transfer upon delivery rather than upon payment, meaning the client owns your work before you are paid.
findings.suggested_change: Upon receipt of full payment for each respective Milestone, Developer assigns to Client all right, title, and interest, including copyrights and patent rights, in and to the custom software code, database schemas, and visual assets developed under this Agreement.

findings.quoted_text: Client shall pay each milestone amount within ninety (90) days after Client's final acceptance of the complete Software.
findings.explanation: Payment is deferred for ninety days after final acceptance, creating a significant and risky delay in receiving your funds.
findings.suggested_change: Client shall pay each milestone amount within thirty (30) days after Client's acceptance of each applicable milestone.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. Before signing the agreement, I have a few small requests. - Regarding the relevant clause on intellectual property, the text transfers rights upon delivery instead of upon payment, so I propose changing this so that rights transfer upon receipt of full payment. - Regarding the relevant clause on payment, payment is deferred for ninety days after final acceptance, so I propose changing this to require payment within thirty days after acceptance of each milestone. Thank you. Best regards,
